features.title: Secret prompt block
features.behavior: beforeSubmitPrompt emits continue:false on known secret-token prefixes.

features.title: Destructive and source-write shell deny
features.behavior: beforeShellExecution denies destructive git/disk/SQL and shell writes of source.

features.title: Secret path Read deny
features.behavior: beforeReadFile denies secret paths; .env.example stays readable.

features.title: Stop churn advisory
features.behavior: stop.sh emits one advisory followup on large rewrites or mass reindent; it cannot refuse completion.

features.title: Stop syntax sensor
features.behavior: stop.sh syntax-checks changed shell/JSON. It does not execute repo test suites.

features.title: Install lifecycle
features.behavior: FORCE=1 install is idempotent; uninstall removes owned files only.

features.title: Doctor inventory
features.behavior: scripts/doctor.sh verifies pack inventory, JSON, and hook registration without claiming live host behavior.

features.title: Pass-state feature gate
features.behavior: A feature may be passing only with recorded evidence. scripts/feature.sh pass is the transition. Editing JSON to passing is not done. Failed pass records lastFailure.nextExperiment and leaves in_progress.

features.title: Schema-validated handoff
features.behavior: state/handoff.json is optional continuity. scripts/handoff.sh check accepts absence and rejects invalid JSON. The file is not authority for new goals.

features.title: Specialist files present and wired
features.behavior: hunter, cut, and prove prompt files exist and are installed by fleet_install.sh. This proves presence and install-wiring only; it does not measure that a review ran, was independent, or caught anything.
features.verification: test -f shared/agents/hunter.md && test -f shared/agents/cut.md && test -f shared/agents/prove.md

evidence.command: test -f shared/agents/hunter.md && test -f shared/agents/cut.md && test -f shared/agents/prove.md

features.title: Glob companions: bare-string globs, distinct headings
features.behavior: Stack companions use bare-string globs and do not share top headings with always-on law. The host attaches them on path match; treating an unmatched-package companion as inert is law, not a test.

features.title: Directory-page map
features.behavior: AGENTS.md is a short map. Details live in docs/, schemas, and harness.json. Always-on law is not an encyclopedia.

features.title: Init readiness probe
features.behavior: scripts/ready.sh reports the L06 bootstrap contract as JSON (can start, can test, can see progress, can hand off). It does not run tests/run.sh.

features.title: Eval coverage check
features.behavior: scripts/eval.sh check requires every requiredEvalDimensions entry to have a tasks[] row with a closed layer and an existing proves file. It does not run tests/run.sh.

features.title: Agent-written reflection on a recorded failure
features.behavior: scripts/feature.sh note <id> <hypothesis> replaces lastFailure.nextExperiment with the agent's diagnosis so the next attempt starts from a reflection, not a raw exit code. It refuses when no failure is recorded and never changes status.

features.title: Read hook stays off the native retrieval hot path
features.behavior: beforeReadFile lifts every file_path/path value in bash; when none matches secret_paths.ere the read is allowed with no interpreter spawn. The JSON codec runs only when a candidate matches (to pick the top-level key), when no key is found, or on escapes outside \\ and \/. Codec resolution is cached per process; emit_allow without a message is static. Deny set unchanged; missing-json applies whenever the codec is actually needed.

features.title: Completion stop advisory
features.behavior: stop.sh emits one advisory when the working tree has unresolved VCS conflict markers or not-implemented stubs added in the change. It stays quiet on ordinary edits. It cannot refuse completion.
